program: [ quote ] map [ 1 dup add quote ] dip swap [ cat ] swap cons map [ dup cat ] map [ i div mul sub ] map
notes: Quote each x, append a (2) built once under the list and bound into a 3-atom body, double to the code (x 2 x 2), and run it through [ i div mul sub ] for x - 2*(x div 2). 30 ops, longest body 4, longest segment 7.

program: [ swap dup add ] dip [ over sub ] dip quote swap [ lt? ] swap cons filter swap quote cat uncons swap drop
notes: Since lo <= hi (the behaviour's interval), hi is strictly nearer iff lo + hi < 2x, i.e. hi < T with T = 2x - lo: keep (hi) under the bound filter (T lt?), append (lo) and take the head. Uses the interval precondition the sampler guarantees; 25 ops.

program: [ quote [ mul ] cat ] map [ [ quote cat ] cat ] map over [ drop [ drop ] ] map cat swap over [ drop 0 ] map swap [ quote cat ] fold [ [ uncons ] dip i ] fold 0 [ add ] fold
notes: Queue zip: ys become actions (y mul quote cat), followed by one (drop) action per x; the queue is xs with zeros appended by a [ quote cat ] fold so it ends on top; the rotation fold [ [ uncons ] dip i ] leaves products plus zeros, which a fold sums. Length-generic, 51 ops.

program: [ quote [ eq? ] cat ] map [ [ quote cat ] cat ] map swap over [ drop false ] map swap [ quote cat ] fold [ [ uncons ] dip i ] fold [ true eq? ] filter 0 [ drop 1 add ] fold
notes: Queue zip: ys become actions (y eq? quote cat), xs padded with one false per y (never equal to an int) is the queue; the rotation fold appends one verdict per y, [ true eq? ] filter drops the verdict misses and the unconsumed queue, and a fold counts. 49 ops.

program: dup nil [ quote cons ] fold dup [ quote ] map [ [ eq? ] cat ] map swap [ over swap filter cons ] fold [ [ drop 1 ] map ] map [ 0 [ add ] fold ] map dup [ 1 sub quote ] map [ [ swap lt? ] cat ] map over [ filter ] fold 0 [ swap drop ] fold [ eq? ] swap cons map [ quote [ cons ] cat ] map [ [ quote cat ] cat ] map swap dup cat [ quote ] map [ [ uncons ] dip i ] fold [ i drop ] filter uncons swap drop i swap drop
notes: Reversed quoted xs is both the accumulator and the source of predicates ((x) eq?), so the [ over swap filter cons ] fold yields occurrence lists in input order ahead of n count-1 singletons; counts, max by candidate-filter fold, is-max flags, a queue zip of flags with xs++xs into (b x) pairs, [ i drop ] filter, first value. 117 ops, long because counts and values must be re-paired.
